title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
description: A 34-year-old hikikomori is kicked out of his home by his family after the death of his parents. After his eviction, he saves a group of teenagers from being killed by a speeding truck, but loses his life in the process. When he comes to, he realizes he has been reborn as Rudeus Greyrat, in a world of swords and sorcery.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 00
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: A 34-year-old unemployed recluse get hit by a truck... and wakes up as a newborn baby in a fantasy world! With loving parents, a lifetime of regrets, and a beginner’s magic textbook, he sets out to make the most of his second chance at life.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Rudy begins training with his new magic tutor and learning swordsmanship from his father. He makes rapid progress, but traumatic memories from his past life leave him to afraid to go outside. Is his second chance already doomed to failure?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Rudy begins to explore the village and rescues a green-haired child from a group of bullies. The two grow close practicing magic, but is there more to Rudy’s new friend than he thinks?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The Greyrat family is overjoyed when Zenith announces that she’s pregnant with a second child, but the mood takes a dour turn when Lilia reveals that she is also pregnant and Paul is the father. Will this be the end of Rudy’s happy family?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Rudy arrives in the city of Roa, where he’s supposed to spend the next five years tutoring the daughter of the local lord. His student, however, is more than he bargained for, and he’ll have to fight to start his first ever job, let alone keep it.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Rudy is officially Eris’s tutor, but she doesn’t want to learn anything but magic. As Rudy struggles to get her interested in other subjects, he realizes that non-stop lessons are causing her stress and proposes a day off in the city.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Eris’s 10th birthday is fast approaching, and her grandfather has invited nobles from across the kingdom to a dance party to celebrate. There’s just one problem: Eris can’t dance, and she’s quickly losing patience with her lessons.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Rudy reaches his 10th birthday, and Eris and her family plan a surprise party for him. Meanwhile, the strange orb hovering over the city remains a mystery as powerful entities across the world begin to take note of it.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Rudy and Eris find themselves stranded in the wilds of the Demon Continent. Their only chance to survive seems to lie in Ruijerd, a warrior of the infamous Superd tribe of demons, but can he be trusted?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd make it to a city. They need to earn money for their journey, and decide to register as adventurers, but Superd like Ruijerd aren’t allowed inside. Rudeus has a plan, but how well will it hold up in practice?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: With their new money-making scheme in place, Dead End head out to track down a mysterious monster. Unfortunately, the job doesn’t go as smoothly as they hope, and Rudy’s plans may turn out to be a lot less safe than he thought.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Dead End discovers that Ruijerd will have to pay a fortune in fees to leave the Demon Continent. As they struggle to find a way around this unexpected roadblock, Rudeus receives another vision.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Roxy arrives on the Demon Continent to begin her search for Paul's missing family. Meanwhile, Rudeus strikes a deal with smugglers to transport Ruijerd across the ocean.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Rudeus finds himself imprisoned by the beast people in Doldia Village. Will Ruijerd and Eris arrive to clear his name before he loses patience and tries to fight his way to freedom?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Dead End decide to wait out the rainy season in the Doldia village. Eris befriends the chieftain's granddaughter, but her fondness for Ghislaine leads to unexpected conflict.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd arrive in the Holy Country of Millis, where Rudeus's thoughts turn to home. When the three split up for a day off, a chance encounter in an alley leads Rudeus to a shocking reunion.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: In the aftermath of their disastrous reunion, Paul and Rudeus reflect on their actions and look for a way forward.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: After setting out from Millishion, Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd board a ship back to the Central Continent. Meanwhile, Roxy arrives in Rikarisu, where she encounters some familiar faces.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Dead End finally arrives in the Shirone Kingdom on the Central Continent. Rudeus is anxious for a reunion with Roxy, but an unexpected vision from the Man-God means he may be in for more than he bargained for.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Rudeus is in desperate straits, imprisoned in a magic-proof dungeon by a despotic prince. But just when all seems hopeless, an unexpected visitor appears with a strange request. Will Rudeus be able to talk his way out of this one?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd are nearing the end of their journey, but a chance encounter in a snowy mountain pass threatens to put a premature end to their adventures.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Rudeus and Eris finally return to Fittoa, but sudden goodbyes and unpleasant news make their homecoming bittersweet.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Rudeus sinks into depression following Eris's departure. As he struggles to get back on his feet, the many people he's met continue their own journeys.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 1 Episode 24
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Rudeus journeys to the harsh northlands in search of his lost mother. Or at least, that's what he tells himself. The scars of his parting from Eris run deep, and getting back on his feet may not be so easy.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Rudeus doesn't want a new party, but he still grows closer to Counter Arrow as he settles into life as a northlands adventurer. When danger rears its head, he finds himself risking it all for his new friends.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Things seem to be looking up for Rudeus. And when Sara asks him on a date, he decides to forget his heartbreak and start a new romance. But putting the past behind him may be easier said than done.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: After two years of adventuring with Soldat, Rudeus is no closer to finding his mother or curing his impotence. But the sudden arrival of a seductive elf and an unexpected offer could send his life off in a whole new direction.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Following the Man-God's advice, Rudeus enrolls in school. He reunites with an old friend and meets potential new enemies, but will he find what he seeks? And what does the future hold for him and the enigmatic "Silent Fitz"?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Rudeus is settling into school life and growing better acquainted with the enigmatic Silent Fitz. But when his efforts to teach Zanoba hit a roadblock, his new friend proposes a drastic solution.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: When Rudeus discovers that two of his new schoolmates have destroyed one of his precious figures, he swears revenge. But while he may be able to trounce schoolgirls in a fight, figuring out what to do with them next won't be so easy.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Love is in the air. First, a smitten classmate seeks Rudeus's help to meet the girl of his dreams. Then the beast people's mating season puts Rudeus in an awkward position—one he'll have to fight his way out of.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Investigating the mass teleportation leads Rudeus to seek out his most elusive classmate: the brilliant Silent Sevenstar. But when he calls at Silent's laboratory tower, he finds a familiar face that he didn't expect—and doesn't welcome.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Rudeus settles into a new routine at the university. But as time passes, Silent Fitz is increasingly in his thoughts. What does he really feel for his enigmatic classmate? And how far will he pry into a friend's secrets to find out?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Ariel confronts Sylphiette with a choice: reveal herself to Rudeus or cut ties with him forever. Determined on one last push to jog Rudeus's memory, Sylphiette invites him on a forest expedition.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Sylphiette reveals herself and Rudeus admits his feelings, but even that isn't enough to cure what ails him. After their heart-to-heart, Sylphiette sets out to end his problem once and for all.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Newly cured and brimming with confidence, Rudeus resolves to marry Sylphie. Just one problem: he has no idea how marriage works in this world. And when friends tell him any newlywed needs a house, he winds up with a haunted mansion.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: The newlyweds have settled into their new home. Next, custom dictates they throw a party for everyone they know. Preparing to host a crowd won't be easy. And even if they pull it off, the big day has surprises in store.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Rudeus receives a letter from Paul. The letter explains that Norn and Aisha, Rudeus's younger sisters, have been sent to join Rudeus. Meanwhile Nanahoshi continues her research into summoning magic for a way to return to her original world.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Rudeus's sisters arrive with an unexpected chaperone. After catching up with an old friend, Rudeus decides it's time to send the girls to school. But convincing Norn and Aisha turns out to be more trouble than he bargained for.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 17
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Life is looking up for Rudeus. His sisters are settling in, and he has plenty of time for friends and family... until an announcement from Sylphie and an unexpected letter upend his idyllic school life.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: With Nanahoshi's help, Rudeus gains a way to shorten his journey, but he and Elinalise will still need to hurry if they hope to return before Sylphie gives birth. Their first obstacle: the harsh desert of Begaritt and its monstrous denizens.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Rudeus and Elinalise reach Rapan and soon reunite with Paul, only to learn that a deadly labyrinth has claimed both Zenith and Roxy. The fruits of Rudeus's studies offer a last, faint hope to reach his mother and his mentor in time.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: With Roxy's rescue, the search for Zenith resumes in earnest. Rudeus reconnects with his mentor amid the perils of the labyrinth. But why does she seem a little more awkward around him than before?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: The rescue party reaches the heart of the Teleporter Labyrinth and confronts its guardian. But when the monster shrugs off Rudeus's magic, they realize they may have bitten off more than they can chew.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Roxy makes a desperate move to pull Rudeus out of his depression. As the group journeys home, both of them must face their feelings and negotiate the consequences.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Rudeus arrives home, frantic that something may have gone wrong in his absence. But the conversations waiting for him may become disasters in their own right. How can he introduce a new wife to a family still reeling from Paul's death?

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Ghislaine takes Eris to train under the Sword God, but Eris's brash attitude angers the other disciples.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Nina continues to eye Eris as a rival, but training with masters of other styles sparks new discoveries.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Rudeus starts a new life with Roxy and Sylphiette, but not all his friends approve of his second marriage.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Fearful of losing more loved ones, Rudeus begs Roxy to teach him a more potent form of magic.

episodes_data.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Rudeus attends Cliff and Elinalise's wedding and goes shopping for his sisters' birthday presents.
